plan.summary: Box-office cost fixes: Chicago weekly cost $250K (unsourced) to a flagged ~$500K estimate; Hamilton $643K cited to Broadway Journal 2018 (2017 figure); Wicked $800K (2008 blog) to Broadway Journal 2023 "well over $1 million"; Great Gatsby notes reconciled with its >$900K cost.
steps: Chicago: weeklyRunningCost 250000 -> 500000, flagged as an estimate, notes and source text say why
Hamilton: mark the $643K as trade-reported and cite it
Great Gatsby: notes say break-even near $1.0M from the >$900K cost; source text dated

actions.description: Was $250K with no source, implausible for a union musical with a full onstage orchestra. No trade or SEC figure exists; the only public figure is a BroadwayWorld forum estimate of $550-600K a week (Aug 2022, https://forum.broadwayworld.com/thread/How-much-longer-can--Chicagolast). $500K is a conservative estimate, flagged as one.
mark the weekly cost as an estimate so /biz prints it with "~"

actions.newValue: Estimate: no weekly cost has been reported. A BroadwayWorld forum estimate (Aug 2022) put it at $550-600K a week.
actions.description: name what the estimate rests on

actions.oldValue: Longest-running American musical in Broadway history. $700M+ Broadway gross. Low-cost concert staging was revolutionary. Weekly cost ~$250K. Recouped. Whitney Leavitt's Feb-Mar 2026 run set highest grossing period in show's 29-year history ($1.46M week of 3/15/26).
actions.newValue: Longest-running American musical in Broadway history. $700M+ Broadway gross. Low-cost concert staging was revolutionary. No weekly running cost has been reported; the ~$500K figure is an estimate for a union musical with a full onstage orchestra. Recouped. Whitney Leavitt's Feb-Mar 2026 run set highest grossing period in show's 29-year history ($1.46M week of 3/15/26).

actions.description: $643K is a reported figure (Broadway Journal, verified 2026-10-10), not our estimate

actions.newValue: Broadway Journal (Apr 25, 2018): fixed expenses averaged $643,000 a week in the year ended July 2017, excluding royalties and percentage rent
actions.description: cite the figure and its 2017 period (https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/hamilton-inc-update-creators-producers-clean-up-as-muzzled-cast-waits-for-it). No newer figure found.

$800K traced only to a 2008 blog post. Broadway Journal (Philip Boroff, Nov 6, 2023): "Its weekly expenses are well over $1 million" (https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/inside-broadways-1-million-nut-cases). $1.0M is that floor.

actions.newValue: Broadway Journal (Nov 6, 2023): weekly expenses "well over $1 million"

actions.oldValue: First Broadway musical led by Korean producer (OD Company). BroadwayWorld: 'now appears unlikely' to recoup - grosses declined ~$250K/week in 2025 vs 2024. Break-even ~$1.0M but recent weeks at $0.9M (82% capacity). Eligible for $3M NY tax credit. Lavish Jazz Age production with 22-person cast, Tony-winning costumes. [Merged from duplicate the-great-gatsby-2024 entry: Musical capitalized at $25 million, opened April 2024, has not yet recouped investment as of January 2025 according to trade reports]
actions.newValue: First Broadway musical led by Korean producer (OD Company). BroadwayWorld: 'now appears unlikely' to recoup - grosses declined ~$250K/week in 2025 vs 2024. Weekly running costs of more than $900,000 put break-even near $1.0M once royalties and rent are added; recent weeks grossed about $0.9M (82% capacity). Eligible for $3M NY tax credit. Lavish Jazz Age production with 22-person cast, Tony-winning costumes. [Merged from duplicate the-great-gatsby-2024 entry: Musical capitalized at $25 million, opened April 2024, has not yet recouped investment as of January 2025 according to trade reports]
actions.description: reconcile with the cost figure: the model puts break-even at ~$966K on a $900K cost; the producer interview gives the cost, not a break-even

actions.newValue: Gordon Cox interview with producer Chunsoo Shin (June 4, 2024): 'weekly running costs ringing in at more than $900,000 per week'
